title: How a page renders today, answered in the inbox and in one doc

chat.text: You asked whether pages still use the little helper functions or are instantiated from JSONL. A Sonnet task mastermind writes the plain answer as one doc under core/Page (classes and helpers write the DOM; page.jsonl deltas are replayed into content blocks on top; which pages are which, with live examples) and posts the three-sentence version as an inbox note.
